6 truths to tell your child before they turn 13. ✏️ One pencil line, one truth, every birthday.

Owen's dad marks his height on the doorframe and writes a truth beside it:
📏 Age 7: Not everyone will like you, and that's okay.
📏 Age 8: A grade shows what you did, not who you are. 📝
📏 Age 9: If someone makes you feel small, don't stay quiet. Ask for help.
📏 Age 10: Your feelings matter, but they don't get to drive. "I'm the worst!"
📏 Age 11: Choose your friends carefully. 🤝
📏 Age 12: No matter what happens, you can always come to me. ❤️

A CDC study of 14,800 teens found those who felt deeply connected at home and at school faced up to 66% less drug misuse as adults.

At thirteen, Dad isn't there in the hallway. But Owen hears him anyway. 👂 Dad's arms can't reach everywhere. But God's love can.

Above the top line, Owen writes Romans 8:39: "Nor height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God in Christ Jesus our Lord." (ESV) 🙏 Jesus proved it on the cross. Held forever.

Your words go with them. Teach them now. ❤️ And if worry is already getting louder, you can walk it together.

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
